Many dimensions of the economy are in the news each month: The total size, the employment situation, consumer confidence, the worth of various large companies. 

Using the internet, find out what's behind these operationalizations of the above dimension:

- GDP as an operationalization of the size of the economy, 
- unemployment rate (which has a specific definition and can do odd things like go down when people give up on looking for work) 
- labor-force participation 
- consumer confidence 
- market capitalization of a company
